content: The river seeks the lowest ground with humility; that is why it becomes an immense, majestic ocean.
author: Kabir
explanation: By choosing the humble low ground without competitive pride, the river effortlessly attracts all streams and gathers boundless strength. Humility is supreme power.
practicalInsight: Step down from being first or having the last word today. Take the humble supportive role.
reflectionPrompt: Where can I trade forceful self-assertion for the receptive power of humility?
